notes.title: Post-PAX Aus 2024: Update and Reminder
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Halloween & Happy PAX Withdrawals!👻 [/h1]

The team had a fantastic time at PAX Aus 2024 and we hope you did too! Thank you to everyone who came by the booth to try the game, grabbed some free merch and candy. We're back in our workstations, continuing development based on feedback we've received from yall!

[b]IF[/b] you've received a 🎃Halloween postcard🎃 from us (see below), this is a gentle reminder that there is a [u]Steam Key on the back[/u] that gives you access to our playtest build. There is no limited time for you to claim the key (for now!), but we would greatly appreciate if you try the build and let us know what you think in our [url=https://discord.gg/bXHqMjJDpD]Discord server[/url]!

Discord community members will also get notified of future playtester intakes first!
